prompt: A cinematic film still captures a village market at dawn. On the far left, an old woman in a blue shawl sits on a wooden crate next to a woven basket filled with bright oranges. A young boy in a striped shirt stands beside her, pointing at a silver coin held by a merchant in a green apron who is handing it over. In the center, a large brown dog lies sleeping on the cobblestones, its head resting near the wheel of a stalled cart. A man in a red scarf leans against the cart, looking at a hanging lantern that sways gently above him. To the right of the cart, a girl in a yellow dress holds a white chicken close to her chest while a black cat watches from atop a stack of clay pots. Behind them, a farmer in a straw hat lifts a heavy sack of grain onto his shoulder, his face turned toward a woman in a purple dress who is inspecting a loaf of bread. Next to her, a child in a grey coat reaches for a red apple on a display table. In the background, two figures stand apart: one in a long black coat observing the scene, and another in a white tunic walking away with a bundle under their arm. There is no modern signage visible anywhere in the frame. There is no electronic equipment present among the stalls.
